# Thomas Lacquet

> Research consultant at Haystack Consulting in Leuven, Belgium. Consumer and customer experience (CX) research for FMCG brands, service companies and banks.

## Profile
- Role: Research Consultant, Haystack Consulting (since January 2022)
- Profile: quantitative researcher, experienced in hybrid research methodologies (quant + qual); member of the extended data science team
- Location: Leuven area, Belgium
- Sectors: FMCG, services, banking
- Study types: product testing, concept testing, usage & attitude (U&A), segmentation, brand health tracking, NPS & customer experience, key driver analysis
- Specialisms: consumer research, CX and NPS analysis, segmentation analysis, behavioural marketing
- Runs market research projects end to end: kick-off, methodology, screener, questionnaire, fieldwork follow-up, analysis, insights
- Member of Haystack's data science & innovation team: makes internal processes more efficient and keeps track of new research methods (e.g. predictive modelling, synthetic data). Uses automatic dashboards in R and Displayr and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) in his own work.
- Recent assignment: CX data analyst at ING Belgium, CoE CX & Innovation (April–June 2026), analysing NPS at bank, channel, product and journey level
- Tools: SPSS, R, Python, Stata, Displayr, Qlik Sense, Power BI
- Languages: Dutch (C2), English (C1), French (B2), German (B1)

## Teaching and speaking
- Yearly guest lecture at UC Leuven-Limburg (UCLL), his former bachelor programme
- Yearly guest lecture for master students at the University of Antwerp
- Guest lecture at PXL
- Speaker at the CUBE marketing network (2024): "Future-proofing our profession"

## Education
- MSc Management, Open Universiteit (2026–2028, in progress, part-time)
- Bachelor of Business Management, Data Driven Marketing, UCLL (2019–2021, magna cum laude)
- Erasmus+ exchange, LAB University of Applied Sciences, Finland (2020–2021)
